shunned2.event: You wish you can turn back time.

shunned3.event: Your paws always feel like they are stained with blood.

shunned4.event: The cats that you thought were your friends look at you with hatred.

shunned5.event: Warriors chase you away from the freshkill pile when you are hungry.

shunned7.event: You wonder if enough time will pass that everycat will forget and things will go back to normal again.

shunned8.event: You go back to your den one night to find your nest ripped to shreds.

shunned9.event: You look upon the freshkill and your stomach grumbles, a reminder that your actions starved you - literally.

shunned10.event: You turn your nose to the bits of scrap fresh kill you're given, regardless of your hunger.

shunned11.event: You spend nights unable to sleep, wondering if murdering was really worth the treatment you get from c_n.

shunned12.event: If you were to leave tonight, would you go unnoticed? Would the Clan search for you?

shunned13.event: A small part of you wishes r_c:0 would just get this over with and exile you already.
